newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps removes Corning from watch.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps removes Corning from watch.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Monday it removed the debt of Corning Inc from rating watch-down and reaffirmed its rating.
Corning's senior unsecured debt is currently rated Single A Plus, and its convertible preferred stock and monthly income preferred securities are rated Single A.

Corning was placed on watch for a possible downgrade last May pending a review of the financial impact from the announced spinoff of Corning Clinical Laboratories (renamed Quest Diagnostics Inc) and Corning Pharmaceutical Services (renamed Convance Inc).
The spinoff, which has since been approved by the Corning board and the Securities and Exchange Commission, will occur on December 31, 1996.

Corning said its long-term debt-to-capital ratio will increase to 40 to 44 percent at year-end from 32 percent at September 30. Management's stated policy is to reduce total debt-to-invested capital into the mid-30 percent range.
Duff & Phelps's rating assumes that Corning can achieve that leverage target within the next two to three years.
